issue.title: Bug: BMC leak escalation logic is not aligned with the HLD

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

According to the [HLD](https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/bmc/sonicBMC/pmon-bmc-design.md) for `get_leak_max_minor_duration_sec()`

_This API could return back 0 if a platform don't support this concept of minor severity leak gets critical over time_

While the current implementation is propagating the leak from MINOR to CRITICAL in 0 seconds:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/blob/c3b1d94d9cc91bd14da2be52ccb8906c81d4594a/sonic-thermalctld/scripts/thermalctld#L681-L686

Logs:
```
ERR pmon#thermalctld: Liquid cooling leakage sensor TestSensor reported leaking
ERR pmon#thermalctld: Leak on sensor TestSensor escalated from MINOR to CRITICAL after 0s
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Simulate a minor leak with `get_leak_max_minor_duration_sec()` = 0.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The leak severity escalation should not happen when the `get_leak_max_minor_duration_sec()` value is 0

resolution.title: Add timestamp to the leak sensor data in DB, Fix to not escalate a minor leak if platform doesn't support it
resolution.description:
#### Description

Couple of enhancements/fixes in this PR

1. Add timestamp to the leak sensor data in DB
2. Fix to not escalate a minor leak if platform doesn't support it
    Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/28218

3. Also update the leak_severity in sensor table to in DB correctly as 'CRITICAL' 'MINOR' and 'None' strings

#### Motivation and Context
If the platform doesn't support escalation of a minor leak --> critical Skip it by checking the return value of platform API is 0
Add timestamp to sensor leak data entry in sensor table -- This will help triage when the leak started.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Unit tests added which mock the leak conditions and test
